name: Drawer
purpose: A page-edge side sheet for focused sub-tasks that keep page context visible: detail inspection, filters, secondary forms. Shares the modal dialog's mechanics (scrim, focus trap, inert background, Esc/close/return-focus — mined from Modals) but docks to the edge instead of centring, so the page remains glanceable. Use Modals for decisions that must interrupt; a Drawer for adjacent detail.

props.name: title
props.$note: Header title (.t-ed-heading-4 .em); labels the dialog via aria-labelledby.

props.name: side
props.$note: Right is the canon dock (detail/inspector pattern). A left variant would mirror trivially but is not canon until a consumer demands it.

props.name: actions
props.$note: Footer actions — primary FIRST, left-aligned (Modals' corrected order); stack full-width at small sizes.

variants.name: detail
variants.use: Read-mostly inspection of a row/card (transaction details) with document-level actions.

variants.name: task
variants.use: A short form completed without leaving the page; the primary action commits and closes.

tokens.font-family: type composites via markup class — title .t-ed-heading-4 .em (400); body .t-ed-body / .t-ed-body-small; buttons .t-cm-button + .t-cm-slot
tokens.buttons: canon Button mirror under .dbtn (namespaced — the .btn type.css binding must not escape its acknowledged blast radius): button/primary/* + tertiary/* roles
tokens.states: colour-only pending button-family partial injection (ADR-0013); close × active adds the token darken (no transform)

motion.entry: Sheet slides translateX(100%)→0 on motion/easing/spring; scrim fades (motion/duration/fade).
motion.reducedMotion: Slide removed — the sheet appears/disappears without transform (2.3.3).

responsive.rule: 400px sheet, full-width ≤480px; footer actions stack full-width there. Body scrolls independently; header and footer are fixed within the sheet.

mustNotNeighbour: A second drawer or open modal (one modal surface at a time)

accessibility.name: Title labels the dialog; close carries aria-label="Close drawer".
accessibility.keyboard: Focus moves in on open; Tab trapped within; Esc closes; focus returns to the trigger; background inert.
accessibility.focus: Visible :focus-visible (focus/ring) on every control; trigger disabled while open.
accessibility.nonText: Secondary button border ≥3:1 vs the sheet surface both modes (1.4.11).

antiPatterns: A drawer for a blocking decision (that is a modal — centred, interruptive)
Scrim click closing a drawer with unsaved form input (confirm first)
Right-aligned actions (family order is primary-first, left-aligned)
Using the .btn classname in a new consumer (type.css blast-radius escape)
Backdrop blur instead of dim (legibility/low-vision cost — Modals ruling)

tokenValidation.against: token store (semantic-colour.json) via #token-manifest — bindings mirror Modals (gated green)
tokenValidation.result: PASS — bound vars match resolved light+dark; declared pairs pass both modes (text ≥14.9, primary label ≥12.6, border ≥3.94).
